name: Durarara!! Relay
source:
It is January in Ikebukuro. Mikado Ryuugamine, Masaomi Kida, and Anri Sonohara are at the opening ceremony of the third quarter of school. In the city, Simon Brezhnev continues handing out leaflets outside Russia Sushi, and Shizuo Heiwajima continues throwing vending machines; nothing out of the ordinary in their daily lives. Yuuhei Hanejima and Ruri Hijiribe star in the movie Case Bodyguard 2: Salaryman Ninja Gu, and like every day, Celty Sturluson completes her deliveries.

[from [url=https://durarara.fandom.com/wiki/Durarara!!_Relay]Fandom[/url]]
translation:
一月的池袋。龙之峰帝人、纪田正臣和园原杏里正在参加第三学期的开学典礼。街头，赛门·勃列日涅夫照旧在露西亚寿司店外发着传单，平和岛静雄照旧扔着自动售货机——大家的日常一如既往。羽岛幽平与圣边琉璃联袂主演了电影《Case Bodyguard 2: Salaryman Ninja Gu》，塞尔提·史特路尔森也和每天一样，完成着自己的运送工作。

[摘自[url=https://durarara.fandom.com/wiki/Durarara!!_Relay]Fandom[/url]]
